name: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach Providers
description: Adult-only Scarlet Peach stream providers for Nuvio. Hanime is the stable schema-v2 provider. HentaiHaven is now included as an experimental second provider using a dedicated Cloudflare resolver based on the current secure player-token/HLS flow.

scrapers.name: Hanime
scrapers.description: Hanime provider for Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata and compatible legacy HentaiStream title slugs. Exact schema v2 Hanime episode mappings bypass catalog search and go directly to the signed AES-GCM handshake. Optional account settings authenticate directly from Nuvio to Hanime and pass only the temporary session token to the resolver for premium qualities. Stream labels follow the Nexus quality/audio standard and include verified censorship metadata when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from Yuzono AniYomi Hanime and anime-src/hanime-stremio

scrapers.name: HentaiHaven
scrapers.description: Experimental HentaiHaven provider. Resolves Scarlet Peach canonical metadata against HentaiHaven, decodes the current x-secure-token player flow, calls the player API, and returns HLS variants using Nexus quality labels. Visible diagnostics remain enabled until Nuvio playback is verified.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol reference from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin HentaiHaven extractor
